chunks: (3) Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id ibn 'Uqdah narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn al-Hasan at-Taymali narrated to us in Safar of the year 274 AH, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Mahboob narrated to us, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I heard Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him) saying:

Fear Allah and seek assistance in your state with piety (war') and striving in obedience to Allah. For the greatest happiness a person has in his religion is when he considers himself to be at the threshold of the Hereafter and this world has cut off from him. When he reaches that threshold, he knows that he has faced bliss and honor from Allah, good tidings of Paradise, and safety from what he feared, and he is certain that which he was upon is the truth, and that whoever opposes his religion is upon falsehood, and that he is perishing. So be glad, and be glad for what you desire. Do you not see your enemies fighting each other in sins against Allah, and killing one another for this world while you are safe in your homes, secluded from them? And sufficient for you is as-Sufyan as a vengeance from your enemy, and he is one of the signs for you. Even if the sinful one (al-Fasiq) rises, you would remain for a month or two after his rising without blame upon you until he kills many people other than you.

Some of his companions said to him: 'What should we do with our families if that happens?' He said: 'The men among you should hide from him, for his anger and greed are only upon our followers. As for the women, there is no harm upon them, if Allah wills.' It was said to him: 'To where do the men escape and flee from him?' He said: 'Whoever of them wishes to leave, let him go to Medina or to Mecca or to some of the countries.' Then he said: 'What do you do in Medina? For the army of the sinful one will aim for it. But you should go to Mecca, for it is your gathering place. And his tribulation is the pregnancy of a woman: nine months, and she will not pass it, if Allah wills.'

key_terms.السُّفْيَان: As-Sufyan, a key figure in Shia eschatology
key_terms.الْفَاسِق: The sinful one, referring to the Khurasani or Sufyan in this context
key_terms.الْوَرَعُ: Piety and caution in religious matters
key_terms.حَمْلُ امْرَأَة: The pregnancy of a woman, a metaphor for the duration of the tribulation
key_terms.مَكَّة: Mecca, identified as the gathering place

ai.seo_question: What are the instructions for Shia during the rise of as-Sufyan according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) contextualizes the Sufyani's emergence within the broader eschatological framework, urging believers to maintain spiritual vigilance (war') and detachment from worldly distractions. He highlights the strategic safety of the Shia will enjoy during the initial phase of the conflict, noting that the tribulation is specifically targeted at the faithful while their enemies are consumed by internal strife. The narration concludes with practical guidance for migration, emphasizing Mecca as the primary refuge due to the specific mechanism of the Sufyani's rise involving a woman, a detail rooted in Shia exegetical tradition.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (3) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from Ali bin al-Hasan at-Taymali from al-Hasan bin Mahboob from Abu Ayyoob al-Khazzaz from Muhammad bin Muslim that Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said:

“Fear Allah, be pious and patient before the distresses of life and try your best to obey Allah. The utmost happiness of a faithful is when he thinks of the afterlife and turns his back to this life and its transient pleasures. If one reaches this degree of faith, he will know that he will get bliss, honor and the reward of being in Paradise. He will feel safe from what he has feared and will be certain that he has been with the truth and those, who oppose his beliefs, are certainly on the wrong path and surely will perish. Be delighted that you will get what you look forward to. Do you not see that your enemies hurry towards sins and kill each other just for the pleasures of this life while you are safe in your houses and away from them? It suffices you that as-Sufyani will avenge you on your enemies. It is one of the signs to you. Although he is sinful but you will be safe for a month or two after his rising until he kills much many people other than you.”

Some of his companions said: “What about our families if that occurs?” He said: “Men are to hide from him (as-Sufyani). His rage is against our followers and women will be safe inshallah.” It was said to him: “Whereto do men escape from him?” He said: “Whoever wants to get away is to go to Medina or Mecca or other countries.” Then he said: “But what do you do in Medina?! His army will attack Medina. You are to go to Mecca. It will be the place of your meeting. It will be a sedition that will not last more than nine months inshallah.”
